## Review verdict

**No major issues found at exact head `8e4aa6304e3773ffbcdefee4aeb2a7e939ce04f7`.**

The round-6 repair is internally consistent:

- Keyed delivery attempts are claimed before operator/channel validation and before the channel transport is invoked; a failed claim propagates without issuing the external attempt. [polis/src/polis/queue/sokrates_arc.pyL888-L915](https://github.com/Skrates/sokrates/blob/8e4aa6304e3773ffbcdefee4aeb2a7e939ce04f7/polis/src/polis/queue/sokrates_arc.py#L888-L915)
- Once an issued keyed attempt fails, retry custody remains with the durable outbox rather than the results-stream entry. [polis/src/polis/queue/sokrates_arc.pyL920-L935](https://github.com/Skrates/sokrates/blob/8e4aa6304e3773ffbcdefee4aeb2a7e939ce04f7/polis/src/polis/queue/sokrates_arc.py#L920-L935)
- The claim publisher preserves a stable attempt identity across at-least-once processing and surfaces publication failures to the caller. [polis/src/polis/queue/sokrates_arc.pyL1098-L1139](https://github.com/Skrates/sokrates/blob/8e4aa6304e3773ffbcdefee4aeb2a7e939ce04f7/polis/src/polis/queue/sokrates_arc.py#L1098-L1139)
- The inbound drain applies the claim through the existing idempotent failure-counting operation, including terminalization handling. [polis/src/polis/queue/inbound.pyL810-L849](https://github.com/Skrates/sokrates/blob/8e4aa6304e3773ffbcdefee4aeb2a7e939ce04f7/polis/src/polis/queue/inbound.py#L810-L849)
- Successful delivery can redeem an attempt that terminalized its row because `mark_delivered` remains intentionally unguarded by terminal state in both the Postgres implementation and its in-memory mirror. [polis/src/polis/pursuit/notices.pyL535-L538](https://github.com/Skrates/sokrates/blob/8e4aa6304e3773ffbcdefee4aeb2a7e939ce04f7/polis/src/polis/pursuit/notices.py#L535-L538) [polis/src/polis/pursuit/notices.pyL668-L671](https://github.com/Skrates/sokrates/blob/8e4aa6304e3773ffbcdefee4aeb2a7e939ce04f7/polis/src/polis/pursuit/notices.py#L668-L671)
- Reclaimed keyed entries continue to defer to the outbox as the single retry owner, avoiding a second independent replay path. [polis/src/polis/queue/sokrates_arc.pyL707-L743](https://github.com/Skrates/sokrates/blob/8e4aa6304e3773ffbcdefee4aeb2a7e939ce04f7/polis/src/polis/queue/sokrates_arc.py#L707-L743)

No repository changes were needed, so no commit or follow-up pull request was created.

**Testing**
- ✅ `git diff --check b39047bb24bc7bce23064f436d97d744e657aa7c..HEAD`
- ✅ `uv run pytest -q polis/tests/test_sokrates_arc.py polis/tests/test_act_plane_inbound.py polis/tests/pursuit/test_actions.py polis/tests/pursuit/test_notices_in_memory.py` — 98 passed.
- ✅ `git status --short --branch` — clean working tree.
- ✅ `git rev-parse HEAD` — confirmed `8e4aa6304e3773ffbcdefee4aeb2a7e939ce04f7`.
